title: Chapter 113 Gene Sample
content:
Chapter 113 Gene Sample

The overall combat power of the Zerg is much greater than that of the Ghouls. As the Zerg's forces continue to increase, the Zerg, with 7,000 Hydralisks as the core, slowly and firmly pushes the front line forward.

"The attack method of the giant ghoul is very similar to a Zerg technology. We need a gene sample. Through the study of this gene, we may be able to unlock a Hydralisks ability in advance."

The Queen of the Zerg suddenly said to Wu Qing.

"Giant ghoul? Hydralisks? Hydralisks?"

After the Queen of the Zerg reminded him, Wu Qing thought of a common name for the Hydralisks. In the game, the attack of the Hydralisks looks like spitting, so it is called a Hydralisks.

The Zerg in this world has been optimized by the system, and reasonable realistic transformation has been made in the game settings.

Wu Qing saw that the Hydralisks' attack was to fire bone spikes, which was similar to large-caliber bullets. He thought that the system settings were like this, so he didn't think about the Hydralisks.

The Queen of the Zerg said this now, it must be that the system has adopted some game settings. The Hydralisks are really hydralisks, but the corresponding technology has not been unlocked yet.

Knowing that the attack of the Hydralisks could be strengthened, Wu Qing immediately became alert. He saw a giant ghoul in the distance just entering the attack range of the Hydralisks and was killed by the Hydralisks.

"Cancel the matter-energy conversion!"

Wu Qing took the initiative to control the system, canceled the matter-energy conversion of the giant ghoul, and left its body.

"Go in that direction, attack with all your strength!"

Wu Qing personally took the lead and killed the giant ghoul.

The Zerg army had a clear goal, the attack force was strengthened again, and the army's advancement speed was also accelerated.

Wu Qing held a long spear in his hand, charging into battle, like a sharp knife, leading the Zerg army to the target position.

It has been a long time since he went into battle to kill the enemy like this. Although he is a Zerg clone, he feels the same as the original body. This refreshing feeling makes him seem to have returned to the time when he led the army of the Empire Era to gallop on the battlefield.

As the master of the Zerg, Wu Qing's emotions can affect the entire Zerg. His fighting spirit is surging, and the Zerg army seems to have gained combat power, and the overall strength has been strengthened again.

Tens of thousands of troops are fighting in this magical underground space, and the Zerg's military strength and combat power have been strengthened, and the ghouls are already a little bit unable to support.

But the number of ghouls is really too many, and no matter how they are killed, they don't seem to decrease. When Wu Qing finally killed the giant ghoul that left a corpse, he couldn't count how many ghouls fell under his gun.

Wu Qing picked off a piece of the giant ghoul's body tissue with a long spear, and took a little corrosive liquid, put it in a container transformed from a biological colonization suit, and carried it with him.

Wu Qing stopped the attack. Except for the ten Zerg guards around him, the other Zerg puppies have been replaced countless times. The ghouls are not vegetarians. With the combat power of the Zerg puppies, following him to charge like this, the battle losses are very large.

After getting the things and fighting for such a long time, it was getting late outside. This underground space was a little far from the Zerg territory. At night, it was unknown what the weirdness of the underground would be like. Wu Qing didn't want to take risks.

So many Zerg troops poured into this underground space through a channel. Now it was also a technical job to withdraw safely.

The Zerg puppies that had entered the underground space began to attack desperately, fighting with the ghouls to earn resources for the system.

Wu Qing took his guards and one-star hydralisks and retreated to the entrance of the channel to rest. The Zerg troops outside no longer provided support and emptied the channel.

As the number of Zerg puppies entering the underground space decreased, the Zerg army began to shrink the front line and retreated step by step to the exit area of the channel.

Seeing the retreat of the Zerg army, the ghouls became more fierce.

Endless ghouls pounced on the Zerg puppies, delaying the speed of the Zerg army's retreat.

The sun was setting and it would soon be night. It seemed that the state of the ghouls became more and more active.

The Zerg army accelerated its retreat. Some Hydralisks had already withdrawn from the passage. The Zerg's battle line was getting shorter and shorter, and the number of troops fighting on the front line was getting smaller and smaller. The extra Zerg Zerglings also began to withdraw from the passage.

When the Zerg army retreated to a small area near the exit of the passage, only a few hundred Hydralisks and a few thousand Zerglings were still fighting.

Wu Qing had not left with his guards and one-star Hydralisks. They had to cover the rear and not let the ghouls follow the Zerg Zerglings all the way.

When thousands of Zerglings were lost, the hundreds of Hydralisks had already withdrawn into the passage and quickly retreated to the Zerg territory.

Fifty one-star Hydralisks were at the end of the Zerg army. The spikes they sprayed were like machine guns shooting, and the ghouls that rushed up were instantly swept down in a large area.

After a wave of output, the fifty one-star Hydralisks withdrew into the passage under the personal protection of Wu Qing and his guards.

After a while, a large number of ghouls poured into the passage.

In the passage, the one-star Hydralisk stopped at intervals to block the ghouls chasing behind, buying time for the retreating Zerg army.

In the relatively limited passage space, the one-star Hydralisk was a high-speed life harvester, and no matter how many ghouls came, they could not rush through.

The Zerg was very fast, coordinated seamlessly, and advanced and retreated in an orderly manner. It didn't take long for them to retreat to the Zerg's underground base.

Wu Qing, the Zerg guards and the one-star Hydralisk who were left behind also successfully retreated to the Zerg territory.

The worker bees who had been waiting nearby quickly collapsed all the tall passages leading to the Zerg underground base. If the ghouls wanted to come over, they had to dig again.

The Zerg underground base is another super huge underground space, and above it is the Zerg ground base.

Where there are Zerg buildings and fungal blankets, it is the territory of the Zerg, which is protected by the world rules and has a rule-level restriction effect on weirdness.

The current Zerg underground base is more exaggerated than the ground base. It is densely packed with defensive buildings. A large number of Zerg troops have burrowed under the fungal blanket to lurk and recover, and the hosts are floating back and forth in the air.

This Zerg underground base looks a bit deserted, but when needed, it will be crawling with Zerg troops in an instant.

Wu Qing's Zerg identity returned to the Zerg base and sent the body tissue and corrosive liquid of the giant ghoul he obtained to a one-star mother nest.

At this time, the sun has set, the night has come, and the weird world has arrived!

On the rock wall in the direction of the Zerg's underground base, ghouls' nests, rubble kept rolling down, and ghouls drilled out from the rock wall one by one.

The huge spikes of the nearby air defense tower whizzed over, smashing the ghouls with one blow, and also collapsed the newly dug passage behind it!

Wu Qing felt that this version of the air defense tower was a super-enhanced version of the Hydralisk. The effect of ground attack was actually quite good, but it was a single shot, unlike the defensive ground spikes, which could attack a large area with one stab. The efficiency of ground attack was completely incomparable to that of the defensive ground spikes.
